subject: general
question: Which of the following teams scored the highest runs in an innings in IPL till 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Royal Challengers Bangalore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chennai Super Kings beat Kolkata Knight Riders by 27 runs in the 14th Indian Premier League 2021 final to win their fourth title.
 
• The final match was held in Dubai on 15 October 2021.
 
• The team had last won the title in the year 2010, 2011, and 2018.
 
• **Royal Challengers Bangalore scored the highest runs in an innings in IPL till 2021.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian Premier League (IPL) 2022 ended with **Gujarat Titans** (GT) lifting the trophy by defeating inaugural champions Rajasthan Royals (RR) at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad. 
 
• The Indian Premier League (IPL) 2022, was the 15th edition of the professional Twenty20 cricket league established by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).
 
• The **15th Edition** of the IPL 2022 recorded a total of 1000 sixes, which is the highest in the history of the tournament.
 
• **1000th** six was hit by PBKS Liam Livingstone (117m) on Mohammed Shami's Ball.
